title: European Master in Migration and Intercultural Relations (EMMIR)
about: EMMIR, an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in migration and intercultural relations, is accepting applications for Edition 14 (2027-2029). Scholarship and non-fee-paying place applications close 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET; fee-paying self-funded applications stay open until 15 July 2027.
requirements: Applicants for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship or a non-fee-paying self-funded place apply by 20 December 2026
Fee-paying self-funded applications remain open until 15 July 2027
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the European Master in Migration and Intercultural Relations (EMMIR) scholarship from the EMMIR Consortium (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master), Oldenburg, Germany, deadline 20 Dec 2026. The photo is a Germany country image showing Cologne Cathedral and the illuminated Hohenzollern Bridge under a starry night sky, not Oldenburg itself.
